reviews.title: Some quirks
reviews.comment: Good mid-case overall. I appreciate the PSU being mounted higher up in the back. Just wished it actually supported a 360mm AIO radiator. The side mount is too short which forces you to install it top mounted, which can cause long term damage to the AIO pump down the line. Also, the rear grates for the PCIe slots cannot be reinstalled. Once you remove them there is no going back, so you have to be 100% certain you're removing the correct one.
